headline: Closing the Tab Doesn't Log You Out of WhatsApp Web, MHA Warns
title: MHA's I4C (National Cybercrime Threat Analytics Unit) advisory dated 18 Nov 2026, reported 23 Nov: a logged-in WhatsApp Web session can be misused to read chats and message contacts/groups as the user; closing the tab/window is not logging out; log out manually; avoid office/shared/cyber-cafe PCs. WhatsApp Help Center: up to four linked devices; linked devices auto-disconnected after 30 days of inactivity; logout via Linked devices.

facts.fact: Advisory issued by MHA's Indian Cyber Crime Coordination Centre (I4C), National Cybercrime Threat Analytics Unit, dated 18 Nov 2026
A logged-in WhatsApp Web session can be misused to read messages, send messages posing as the user and reach contacts and group chats
Closing the browser tab or window is not logging out; log out manually after every session
Avoid staying logged in on office/shared computers; avoid cyber cafes, public kiosks, borrowed computers; if unavoidable, private browsing on a trusted computer and log out before closing
WhatsApp allows up to four linked devices at a time
WhatsApp automatically disconnects linked devices after 30 days of inactivity (so a session in use is not dropped by that rule)
Logout path: Android three-dot menu > Linked devices; iPhone Settings > Linked devices; tap the device > Log out
